events.description: Display the Euler formula equation V - E + F = 2 at the top of the screen and initialize a single vertex with a 'Trivial graph' label and arrow.
events.clip_query: A math equation V - E + F = 2 displayed at the top with a single dot labeled as a trivial graph below it.

events.description: Sequentially flash the V, F, and E variables in the equation, fading in their corresponding initial values (1, 0, 1) and flashing the background to represent the outer face.
events.clip_query: Highlighting variables in the Euler equation and showing the numbers 1, 0, and 1 appear underneath them.

events.description: Animate the addition of a new edge and a new vertex, displaying a text label 'New edge -> New vertex' and dynamically incrementing the V and E counters.
events.clip_query: An edge drawing from the first vertex to a new vertex, with text indicating a new edge and vertex, and the formula counters updating.
